documents.title: Annual report extract
documents.text:
Annual report extract: Ferrovane Foods (fictional, authored test material).
For Ferrovane Foods, recurring revenue share in FY2024 was 70.1%, as originally reported. Gross debt at Ferrovane Foods stood at $202.7m in FY2025 (reported basis), second issue (corrects the first issue). Ferrovane Nordic, a subsidiary had debt service cover ratio of 1.94x in FY2025. For Ferrovane Oy, senior leverage in FY2024 was 2.76x.

documents.title: Quarterly lender update
documents.text:
Quarterly lender update: Ferrovane Foods (fictional, authored test material).
For Ferrovane Foods, free cash flow in FY2025 was $48.3m (reported basis). Cash on balance sheet at Ferrovane Foods stood at $10.3m in FY2025 (reported basis). Ferrovane Foods had recurring revenue share of 81.4% in FY2024, as restated in the latest accounts. For Ferrovane Foods, gross debt in FY2025 was $228m (reported basis), first issue. As to Ferrovane Foods, the security package is: first-lien security over all material subsidiaries.

documents.title: Independent business review
documents.text:
Independent business review: Ferrovane Foods (fictional, authored test material).
For Ferrovane Foods, free cash flow in H1 2025 was $22m (reported basis). Cash on balance sheet at Ferrovane Foods stood at $12.9m in FY2023 (reported basis). Ferrovane Foods had debt service cover ratio of 1.5x in FY2025. For Ferrovane GmbH, senior leverage in FY2024 was 3.56x. As to Ferrovane Foods, the security package is: unsecured, ranking pari passu with trade creditors.
